description: This file contains tests for the 'observability_webhook' feature in the 'ui' package, including handlers for getting, setting, deleting webhook configurations, status reporting, redrive operations, and dead letter queue management. It uses the Gin framework for routing and includes mock components for testing.

classes.name: mockForwarder
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ObservabilityForwarder interface used for testing various webhook operations, providing stubbed methods to simulate different statuses and responses.

methods.name: setupTestEnvironment
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, including storage, mock forwarder, handler, and router with registered routes.

methods.name: TestGetWebhookHandler_NotConfigured
methods.description: Tests retrieving the webhook configuration when none is set.

methods.name: TestGetWebhookHandler_Configured
methods.description: Tests retrieving the webhook configuration when it has been configured.

methods.name: TestSetWebhookHandler_Create
methods.description: Tests creating a new webhook configuration via POST request.

methods.name: TestSetWebhookHandler_MissingURL
methods.description: Tests validation failure when URL is missing in the webhook configuration request.

methods.name: TestSetWebhookHandler_InvalidURL
methods.description: Tests validation failure when URL is not valid.

methods.name: TestSetWebhookHandler_NonHTTPURL
methods.description: Tests rejection of non-HTTP(S) URLs such as FTP.

methods.name: TestSetWebhookHandler_DefaultsEnabled
methods.description: Tests that the default value of 'Enabled' is true if not specified.

methods.name: TestDeleteWebhookHandler
methods.description: Tests deletion of the webhook configuration.

methods.name: TestGetStatusHandler
methods.description: Tests retrieving the status of the webhook forwarder.

methods.name: TestGetStatusHandler_NoForwarder
methods.description: Tests status retrieval when no forwarder is configured.

methods.name: TestRedriveHandler_Success
methods.description: Tests successful redrive operation.

methods.name: TestRedriveHandler_PartialFailure
methods.description: Tests redrive operation with some failures.

methods.name: TestRedriveHandler_NoForwarder
methods.description: Tests redrive attempt with no forwarder configured.

methods.name: TestGetDeadLetterQueueHandler
methods.description: Tests retrieving dead letter queue entries.

methods.name: TestGetDeadLetterQueueHandler_Pagination
methods.description: Tests dead letter queue retrieval with pagination.

methods.name: TestGetDeadLetterQueueHandler_Empty
methods.description: Tests retrieving dead letter queue when empty.

methods.name: TestGetDeadLetterQueueHandler_LimitCap
methods.description: Tests limit capping when requesting DLQ entries.

methods.name: TestClearDeadLetterQueueHandler
methods.description: Tests clearing the dead letter queue.

methods.name: TestClearDeadLetterQueueHandler_Empty
methods.description: Tests clearing an already empty DLQ.

methods.name: TestParseIntParam
methods.description: Tests helper function for parsing integer query parameters with various inputs.

methods.description: Helper function to create a string pointer.
